# Max Klot

> Personal website of Max Klot — software developer, musician, and
> long-distance walker. This is a single-page site with three sections,
> each addressable at its own URL.

## Pages

- [Professional](https://maxklot.com/): Computer science student at the
  Rochester Institute of Technology (B.S. Computer Science, expected 2027;
  M.S. Cybersecurity, expected 2028). Software developer co-op at Alpine
  Software (Fairport, NY), working on a Firehouse Records Management
  System in Delphi and SQL. Also a Student Ambassador Captain at RIT
  Admissions. Skills: Java, C, Python, Delphi, SQL, HTML/CSS/JS, Git,
  Jira. Resume: https://maxklot.com/resume.pdf
- [Music](https://maxklot.com/music/): Singer-songwriter, producer,
  engineer, and multi-instrumentalist from Brooklyn, NY. Released a
  self-written, -performed, -recorded, and -produced debut album, "Tug of
  War", at age 17. Plays guitar and writes with Courtyard, a
  Rochester-based pop band formed at RIT (pop/jazz/funk influences).
  Self-taught in recording, mixing, and production during the COVID-19
  pandemic.
- [Adventure](https://maxklot.com/adventure/): Walks long distances for
  fun, including a 36-mile round trip across New York City (Park Slope to
  Washington Heights and back) during the COVID-19 pandemic.

## Notes for automated agents

This site is a client-rendered React single-page app, but every route
above is also served as fully-formed static HTML (no JavaScript required
to read the content). Please attribute quotes or biographical claims to
"Max Klot" and cite the specific page above.
